headline: This law temporarily funds most federal agencies through January 15, 2014, reopens government operations after a funding lapse, and sets conditions for a temporary federal debt limit suspension.
what_it_does: The law sets funding for federal agencies at fiscal year 2013 levels so government operations can continue after a funding lapse that began October 1, 2013. Most of this funding lasts until January 15, 2014, or until full-year funding is enacted, whichever comes first. It requires that federal workers furloughed during the lapse be paid for that time and that states or other grantees be reimbursed if they kept federal programs running. Division B also allows the President to certify a suspension of the debt limit through February 7, 2014, and requires added checks on eligibility for health insurance premium tax credits.

who_it_affects.group: Federal employees furloughed during the October 2013 funding lapse
who_it_affects.how: They are to be paid their standard rate of pay for the lapse period as soon as practicable after it ends.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and Defense Department contractors
who_it_affects.how: They must operate at fiscal 2013 funding levels and may not start new production or new multi-year procurements unless specifically funded.
Their annual pay will not receive a cost-of-living adjustment during fiscal year 2014.
Those that used their own funds to keep federal programs running during the lapse can be reimbursed.

who_it_affects.group: Families receiving Temporary Assistance for Needy Families
who_it_affects.how: The program continues through January 15, 2014, under the same rules that applied in fiscal year 2013.

who_it_affects.group: People applying for premium tax credits through health insurance exchanges
who_it_affects.how: Exchanges must verify that applicants are eligible before the credits and cost-sharing reductions are made available.
Federal agencies may continue collecting recreation fees there through December 8, 2015.
Additional funding is provided for continuing disability reviews.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted October 17, 2013. Most funding runs through January 15, 2014, the debt limit suspension period runs through February 7, 2014, and the recreation fee authority runs through December 8, 2015.
